top_signals.title: Microsoft pulls out of Nscale deal for UK’s largest AI data centre
top_signals.summary: Microsoft has pulled out of plans to build the UK’s largest AI data centre in a deal with Nscale. The global tech giant, which had previously planned to fund a supercomputer at the site, has ended its involvement in the partnership leaving Nscale scouting for alternative power resources. Plans were first announced last year, with [...]
